summary: Legacy post-processor scripts now run the path through cannedCycleTerminator, so every canned-cycle group in their output is wrapped in a literal G98/G99 and G80 and the Drilling operation's KeepToolDown (G99) setting is honoured; cannedCycleTerminator itself now also terminates tapping cycles and keeps a literal G98/G99 as fallback.

pages.reason: Path/Post/scripts/*_legacy_post.py parse(): every legacy script (linuxcnc, grbl, marlin, estlcam, rrf, fanuc, uccnc, dynapath, dynapath_4060, mach3_mach4, centroid, KineticNCBeamicon2) now wraps each canned-cycle group in a literal G98/G99 ... G80 (see TestFanucLegacyPost expected blocks); legacy flow now honours Drilling KeepToolDown; heidenhain_legacy_post still does not

Path/Post/Utils.py cannedCycleTerminator(): now matches GCODE_DRILL_EXTENDED (G84/G74 tapping) as well as CmdMoveDrill, inserted G98/G99/G80 carry the cycle's annotations, un-annotated cycles fall back to the last literal G98/G99, and the retract word is placed before a preceding M29 for rigid tapping

All legacy scripts now call PostUtils.cannedCycleTerminator(PathUtils.getPathWithPlacement(pathobj)) before their per-command scan; a custom legacy script must do the same to see the retract mode, and dynapath_legacy_post.export() now returns the G-code string and accepts filename '-' like the other scripts
KeepToolDown property is unchanged; the PR only makes legacy posts honour the G99 annotation Path/Op/Drilling.py already emitted, restoring documented behaviour
Path/Main/Job.py: module-level Instances() removed and replaced by PathScripts.PathUtils.jobInstances(); JobCmd.py/JobDlg.py only switch callers, no visible dialog or property change

meta.title: CAM: legacy post scripts silently drop G99 retract mode
